name: Montez Sweat
head: https://a.espncdn.com/i/headshots/nfl/players/full/3134690.png
college: Mississippi State; Copiah-Lincoln Junior College; Michigan State

inj.note: The defensive end is set to return to practice in Week 8 and should play in the team's Monday Night Football showdown against the Seahawks. Sweat has logged seven tackles (two solo), including 2.0 sacks, over his five regular-season appearances so far in 2026.

news.h: Montez Sweat returns to Bears following 'devastating' 2-game suspension
news.d: Bears DE Montez Sweat is back with the team following his "devastating" two-game suspension violating the NFL's performance enhancing substances policy.
